# gitmoap_groups (Data Source)

List groups. Without a parent, lists top-level groups; with `parent_group_id` or `parent_group_path` (not both), lists that group's subgroups. Newest first, and only the groups the caller can see — public ones without signing in — so a page can hold fewer than `limit` groups while more remain (at most 100 per page).

The token needs `group:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `parent_group_id` (String) Filter by parent group ID (mutually exclusive with parent_group_path)
- `parent_group_path` (String) Filter by parent group path (mutually exclusive with parent_group_id)

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `ancestor_group_ids` (List of String)
- `avatar` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `full_path` (String)
- `group_id` (String)
- `group_name` (String)
- `parent_group_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `verified_domains` (List of String) The domains the organization has proven it controls, each through a DNS record. Only an
organization — a top-level group — has any; omitted when it has none.
- `visibility` (String)
